title: [Red Skies, Main Deck]
description: Freshly swabbed, the wooden planks of the main deck are painted a deep crimson.  Iron-ringed masts rise up from the center of the ship, their rigging blackened with pitch, and overhead, the canvas sails hang like tattered scarlet wings flapping in the salt-laced sea breeze.  Coils of rope and stacked barrels line the railings, while a great wheel of dark cocobolo wood stands aft, its surface polished smooth by the hands of countless helmsmen.
